race.comment: BREECHES (4) gets top billing in a competitive BM50, chiefly because her recent form has been sound enough for this grade. She was beaten just under four lengths at Townsville at big odds after beginning awkwardly, and her 1000m record gives her a strong grounding despite the weight query. TO LOVE SOMEBODY (5) is the obvious danger after being beaten just under three lengths in a Townsville BM55 on soft ground, with the stewards noting he had difficulty getting clear from the home turn to the 200m. TARONG (6) brings a different profile, dropping from a 3-4yo Open where he made ground after early and mid-race issues, so this looks a more suitable assignment if he begins cleanly. SPEEDY TARGET (3) is the in-form runner of the quartet, having won at Mareeba then run second in a BM55 at Bowen, and he appeals as the solid each-way chance.
